findings: Image input works on the review model: still/contact-sheet review (AUTOPILOT 2.3) is technically possible; its judgement is not calibrated.
A video URI without videoMetadata is sampled at about 1 fps (4273 tokens for 47.8 s, ~89 tokens/s); native-review uses 4 fps, so any review/calibration must set fps=4 explicitly to be comparable.
Latency: 100-178 s for one multimodal call; client timeouts must be >= 600 s, and a timeout is UNCERTAIN (never resubmitted).
